sub_area: Access log creation on export, file download, and method calls
rationale: Tests the Python AccessLog doctype's make_access_log helper and CSV export logging, all invoked directly via frappe in-process. Ferro does not implement access logging as a subsystem; this is a Python app-layer audit trail.

sub_area: Login/logout activity logging and brute-force lockout policy
rationale: Tests Frappe's LoginManager session auth path (CookieManager, brute-force lockout, consecutive login attempt limits), all in-process Python. Ferro has no session auth and intentionally does not implement login policy enforcement.

rationale: Tests the AuditTrail/doc-comparator Python subsystem that diffs amendment chains via frappe.copy_doc and comparator.compare_document(), entirely in-process. This is a Python document-lifecycle feature ferro does not reimplement.

sub_area: Background Task doctype lifecycle: enqueue, execute, callbacks, retry, stop
rationale: Tests Python task_queue helpers (_execute_task, enqueue_task, retry_task, stop_task) and BackgroundTask DocType lifecycle entirely in-process with mocked RQ. Ferro's jobs.rs is an in-process replacement, but this Python-level API is not what ferro exposes.

sub_area: Comment creation, _comments cache update, public comment spam/XSS filtering
rationale: Tests the Comment doctype's Python controller logic (add_comment, XSS filtering, blog comment moderation) entirely in-process. Ferro does not reimplement comment subsystem logic.

rationale: Tests the Communication doctype's Python controller (email parsing, deduplication, linked contacts, get_communication_data) and email sending mechanics; all in-process. Email and communication subsystems are outside ferro's scope.

sub_area: Communication email mixin: recipients, CC, BCC, sendmail, attachments, undo send
rationale: Tests the Communication email mixin methods (make, add_attachments, undo_email_send) and EmailQueue interactions entirely in Python. These are email-subsystem internals ferro intentionally does not implement.
